data.name: Baheeja
data.gender_notes: Baheeja is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ba-ha-ja', meaning 'to shine, to illuminate'. In Islamic context, Baheeja symbolizes the light of Allah that guides and illuminates the path of the believer. The name Baheeja carries the meaning “Light of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baheeja usually hope their child will grow to embody light of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and enlightenment in the journey of faith.
data.etymology: Baheeja belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baheeja total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
